name: tpl-response-1-nogoal~p1
task: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a 'whenever' condition: every moment with blocker_moved requires has_door_key then or later. A hard Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key) captures exactly this; the consequent is a rule, not a goal, so the empty FINAL_STATES and rule-only warning are valid. Re-owing each step while the lasting condition holds matches 'at every moment ... or pick it up later'.

texts: Whenever the ball is out of the way of the door, the agent must be carrying the door key at that moment or at some later moment.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key) -> u1
(u1, has_door_key) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, has_door_key, u0) -> 1
